name: Atropos
summary: Atropos is Nous Research's framework for reinforcement-learning environments with LLMs. Environments run as services and send scored trajectories to a central trajectory API, from which a separate trainer pulls batches; it covers dataset, game, multi-turn tool-calling, code-execution and RLAIF environments. The GitHub repository was archived in July 2026 and is no longer maintained.
facts: RL environments plus a trajectory API; trainer and inference not included
goodFor: Turning agent trajectories into RL training data
Research on tool-calling and multi-turn RL
watchOut: Repository archived; no further fixes or security patches
Requires your own trainer and inference setup
